findings.message: 137 one-day moves in the price series match recorded splits: the returns were computed from unadjusted prices.
No test window or opened holdout: every number is in-sample.
Sharpe 0.04 at modelled costs, -1.42 at double.
Sharpe 0.04 falls to -0.10 when the 40 best and 40 worst periods are trimmed.
Positive Sharpe in fewer than half of the volatility regimes.
